about: The interface's view model of one character (Noesis), made and updated by gui::ViewModelProvider on the client's UI update.

evidence.says: +0x420 is read as gui::VMPlayerCharacterProperties by unplaced::UpdateCharacterActiveDialogue and made by unplaced::GetOrCreatePlayerCharacterProperties; +0x528 is written by unplaced::UpdateCharactersPlayable, the dx11 place of the Toolkit's +0x540 (UpdateIsPlayableCharacter), and the snapshot read IsPlayableCharacter false while it was 0.
